messages.subject: segmentation fault in crash
parts:
Dear all,

I am running an INLA model (with verbose=TRUE), and it is almost finished. I have seen the printed DIC, and the following information. However, INLA crashed and gives the following error message about segmentation fault. Does anyone have experience on what has happend?

thanks

Lisa

thx.
